messages:
jules: Kicking off staged canary for feature flag `session-prefetch` in us-east-1 during the 2h change window. Ramp plan: 2% -> 15% -> 60% with 8m soak between steps. Pin prefetch-svc to v1.8.0 for canary cohort. tagging release-note: 'session-prefetch canary'. @oncall-west see below.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Canary start confirmed. rollout_id=rb-5078901234. Executing preflight checks (env, migrations, smoke).

tereza: Preflight: migrations none, smoke traffic ok, heap / GC normal. Baseline p95 captured. Proceed with 2%.

deploy-bot: Action: `ffctl set session-prefetch --region=us-east-1 --percentage=2 --rollout-id=rb-5078901234`
-> output: success (applied to 2% of traffic).

oncall-west: Observing metrics dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/prefetch/session-prefetch?orgId=1 :eyes: I'll watch 5xx, downstream error_rate and CPU. Alerting thresholds: errors>1% sustained 90s -> mute & fast-disable; errors>2% sustained 60s -> open incident.

raj: Note: prefer fast-disable over service rollback unless there are infra regressions. We should also be ready to pin traffic back to v1.7.9 if needed: `/ops/deploy rollback prefetch-svc --to v1.7.9 --region us-east-1`.

jules: Agree. Runbook steps for this thread: 1) fast-disable flag in region, 2) if still bad, rollback prefetch-svc to v1.7.9, 3) if infra-level impact, escalate to SRE.

deploy-bot: Telemetry check @t+6m: error_rate=0.45% (1m), p95 latency +4ms. No auto actions. Scheduling 15% at t+8m.

tereza: Applying 15% now.

deploy-bot: Action: `ffctl set session-prefetch --region=us-east-1 --percentage=15 --rollout-id=rb-5078901234`
-> output: success.

oncall-west: Post-step: error_rate rose to 1.1% (1m window), CPU stable, p95 +25ms. Crossing first alert bucket but under incident threshold. Monitoring closely.

jules: Hold the 60% move if error_rate stays above 1.0% at next checkpoint. We'll re-evaluate at t+18m.

ops-bot: /note Added to release notes draft: "session-prefetch canary (us-east-1) — prefetch-svc pinned v1.8.0. Watch errors and p95. On-call: @oncall-west"

raj: Quick commands reminder in-thread:
- fast-disable flag: `ffctl set session-prefetch --region=us-east-1 --percentage=0 --rollout-id=rb-5078901234`
- staged rollback: `/ops/deploy rollback prefetch-svc --to v1.7.9 --region us-east-1`
- force drain: `/ops/drain region us-east-1 --service prefetch-svc`

tereza: At t+12m: error_rate trending down to 0.9%. p95 trending to +12ms compared to baseline. No action.

deploy-bot: Scheduled 60% at t+18m. If any of the following trigger, deployment will be stopped: error_rate >= 2% sustained 60s OR p95 >= 200% of baseline for 120s.

jules: Reminder: don't rollback the whole cluster unless we see infra (OOMs, node restarts). Flag-only fast-disable is our first throttle.

oncall-west: FYI muted noisy latency alerts, keeping error alerts at default. Will open incident if error_rate >2% for 1m.

tereza: Log sample from canary (t+9m):
```
2026-04-03T14:09:12Z prefetch-svc request_id=xyz987 user=uid123 hit_prefetch=true latency_ms=18 success=true
```
no anomalies in traces.

raj: If 60% looks stable we'll include a short blurb in the release notes and schedule a regional unpin to allow global rollout. Keep the pinned v1.8.0 until 70%+ stable for 30m.

deploy-bot: Update t+20m: 60% applied. Action: `ffctl set session-prefetch --region=us-east-1 --percentage=60 --rollout-id=rb-5078901234` -> success.

oncall-west: Post-60%: error_rate=1.35% (1m), p95 +30ms. No incident. Team to monitor 30m soak; recommended plan: if steady under 1.8% we'll proceed to global ramp tomorrow.

jules: Thanks all. I'll finalize release notes: "session-prefetch canary completed in us-east-1; prefetch-svc pinned to v1.8.0 during canary; no incident; watch p95/5xx for 30m soak." Will call for post-mortem if we hit error thresholds.

ops-bot: /comment release-notes updated (id: RN-2026-041).
